Tosafot on Bava Batra 53a:2:1.hebrew: אמר שמואל ומאי תבעי ליה לאבא ומה מכר כו' - אע"ג דשמואל אית ליה ספ"ק דב"מ (דף טו.) דיפה כח מתנה מכח מכר, לענין דלא טריף מיניה את השבח — היינו אחר שכבר נתקיימה המתנה, כדפ"ה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 53a:2:1.english: Shmuel said: And what was Abba asking? "And what did he sell?" etc. - Even though Shmuel holds, in the end of the first chapter of Bava Metzia (15a), that the power of a gift is stronger than the power of a sale, in regard to the point that [the original owner] cannot seize the improvement from him — that is [only] after the gift has already been established, as Rashi explains.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 53a:4:1.hebrew: טובא עבד - ואין זה "כל שהוא", אלא כו'. ו"נעל" נמי "כל שהוא" צריך ליישב כעין הני:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 53a:4:1.english: "He accomplished a great deal" - But this is not [a case of] "a bit," but rather etc. And [the mishnah's case of] locking, too, [where it says] "a bit," must be explained in a manner similar to these [cases].

Tosafot on Bava Batra 53a:5:1.hebrew: האי פרצה היכי דמי אילימא דמעיקרא לא עיילי בה והשתא נמי לא עיילי בה מאי עבד - נראה דל"ג, דהיכי מצינן למימר "השתא נמי לא עיילי", הא כדי שיכנס ויצא בה קאמר. לכך נראה כספרים דגרסינן: "דמעיקרא לא עיילי בה, והשתא עיילי בה — טובא עבד":
Tosafot on Bava Batra 53a:5:1.english: "This breach – what is the case? If you say that originally they did not enter through it, and now too they do not enter through it, what has he done?" - It appears that this is not the correct reading, for how can we say "now too they do not enter through it," when [the Gemara] is speaking of [a breach wide enough] that one could enter and exit through it? Therefore, it appears [correct to follow] the manuscripts that read: "Originally they did not enter through it, but now they do enter through it — he has done a great deal."
